{{Quote|What do you mean, the ''Falcon'' thinks she's on a mission to destroy the Galactic Senate?!! The Senate was dissolved last&mdash;''waitaminute''! Now I get it!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="MYS" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] fell under the control of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] and went on an outdated suicide '''mission''' to destroy the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
